lines.zero.join: PLAYERS 2-4: PRESS START ON A PAD (2 ON THE KEYBOARD)

notes.zero.title: The anti-gravity racer's title, on its menu.
notes.zero.menu.gp: A mode: both tracks in a row, points for each place.
notes.zero.menu.city: A track: a circuit through a city at night (a single race).
notes.zero.menu.sky: A track: a ribbon raised in the air over a desert (a single race).
notes.zero.menu.vs: A mode: two to four players in a split screen.
notes.zero.menu.next: After a race: the next race (or the same again).
notes.zero.join: Waiting for more players: each presses Start on a game pad, or 2 on the keyboard.
notes.zero.boost: {key} is the key or button that spends energy for a burst of speed.
notes.zero.row: A row of the results: {place} is the place, {name} the pilot's name.
notes.action.boost: A control's name, and its touch button: a burst of speed that costs energy.
